name: Runemaster Alteration rank 1 strengthens every Runic Tattoo by 25%, Water included (#1393)
contract: Tooltip 705619 (Alteration Rank 1, CharacterAdvancement 6493 rank 1): 'Increases the effectiveness of your Runic Tattoos by $s1%'.
Its only effect is aura 108 SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS with BasePoints 24 (+25%), resolved natively like rank 2 (707875, #531).
Rank 1's family 38 mask is 0x00000004/0/0x00004022; it lacks 0x00200000, the family flag of every Water tattoo rank (801107, 803783-803785).
Rank 2's mask 0x00200004/0/0x00004020 and the shared tooltip include Water, so rank 1 must reach Water too.
The native modifier multiplies each tattoo effect value and truncates the result.
Earth rank 1 therefore gives 93 instead of 75 armor and 6 instead of 5 Nature resistance.
A Water tattoo cast with rank 1 regenerates 1.25 times the mana of the same tattoo on an unmodified player (42 -> 52).

steps.label: Alteration rank 1 raises Earth's armor by 25% (75 -> 93)
Alteration rank 1 raises Earth's Nature resistance by 25% (5 -> 6)
The stronger tattoo reaches the character's armor
Let the tattoo category cooldown pass
Control: Runic Tattoos: Water is active
Alteration rank 1 raises a newly cast Water tattoo's mana regeneration by 25%
Removing Alteration returns Water to its normal strength
